No power capacity in MW is published on this page.

reading.body:
Alpha Federal occupies 80,000 square feet in South Charleston and is described by its operator as a Global Data Center, but the operator publishes no power capacity figure for this facility. Without stated power draw, colocation density, or intended workload, the campus capacity for AI workloads cannot be assessed from the operator's own disclosures.

West Virginia has two mapped data center facilities and publishes no megawatt capacity figures from any operator in the state. Alpha Federal would rank first by published capacity only because no competitor facility in the state has disclosed a power figure to The World of AI.

The absence of published power specifications is the binding constraint here. A 80,000-square-foot facility could range from a small on-premises data center to a meaningful colocation site depending on cooling and power infrastructure, but the operator has not stated either. Until power capacity is published, this campus cannot be ranked against AI scaling infrastructure elsewhere.
